fundamental.summary: No actionable signals detected across insider, institutional, government, or retail channels; earnings in 89 days presents timing risk with minimal conviction support.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (251.5) indicates extreme market stress, and financial sector faces elevated credit stress; earnings in 89 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.
